content: When anger rises, think of the consequences.
author: Confucius
explanation: Anger acts as an emotional intoxicant that obliterates long-term perspective. A momentary impulse of fury frequently creates wreckage that requires decades of repentance to heal.
practicalInsight: When feeling triggered today, pause for three deliberate breaths and visualize the wreckage of reactive speech before responding.
reflectionPrompt: What past instance of unchecked anger taught you the severe cost of momentary emotional reactivity?
